profile.summary: Medical Doctor and Associate Professor of Pathology specializing in Pancreatobiliary, Gastrointestinal, and Digital Pathology. Experienced in clinical diagnostics, machine learning applications in anatomic pathology, statistical modeling, and biomedical data science with R and Python. Developer of open-source clinical research tools (ClinicoPath Jamovi module) and Turkey's first comprehensive digital Whole Slide Image (WSI) histopathology atlas.
profile.summary_tr: Gastrointestinal ve Pankreatobilier Patoloji, Dijital Patoloji ve Biyoistatistik alanlarında uzman Türk hekim ve araştırmacı. Memorial Sağlık Grubu Patoloji Laboratuvarı'nda uzman hekim ve serbest akademik danışman olarak görev yapmaktadır.
profile.motto: In God we trust. All others must bring data. / Data driven ethical decision making.

experience.description: Diagnostic surgical pathology with primary focus on Pancreatobiliary and Gastrointestinal specimens. Implementation and leadership of full digital pathology workflows and routine Whole Slide Imaging (WSI) diagnostic operations in a high-volume private hospital network.

Conducted international collaborative cancer research, bibliometric analyses, statistical design, developed open-source medical software (ClinicoPath Jamovi module), and educational digital platforms (Patoloji Atlası).

software.name: ClinicoPath Jamovi Module
software.description: Comprehensive statistical analysis module for clinical researchers, pathologists, and oncologists. Provides Kaplan-Meier survival analysis, Cox proportional hazards regression, ROC curve generation, Decision Curve Analysis (DCA), and publication-ready tables without writing R code.

software.name: Patoloji Atlası (Histopathology Atlas)
software.description: The first open-access Turkish digital pathology atlas featuring hundreds of annotated Whole Slide Images (WSI), interactive deep-zoom virtual microscopy, diagnostic criteria, and comprehensive pathology lecture notes for medical students and residents.

software.name: jsurvival
software.description: Jamovi statistical module dedicated to medical survival analysis: generates publication-quality Kaplan-Meier plots, log-rank tests, hazard ratios, and pairwise survival comparisons.

software.name: meddecide
software.description: Diagnostic test accuracy evaluation tool for clinicians: computes sensitivity, specificity, positive/negative predictive values, likelihood ratios, diagnostic odds ratios, and visualizes Fagan nomograms.

software.name: jjstatsplot
software.description: Jamovi module bringing rich statistical details to ggplot2 visualizations, integrating statistical test results directly into graphics.

software.name: webR & ShinyLive In-Browser Analytics
software.description: Zero-server, client-side execution of R data analysis and Shiny applications directly inside the browser using WebAssembly (Wasm), facilitating reproducible and universally accessible clinical calculators.

software.name: Histopathology Research Template
software.description: Standardized R and RMarkdown pipeline template for clinicopathologic studies, pathology registry cleaning, and automated statistical reporting.
